name: 薪资核算与工资项目版本

pagesAdded.notes: 默认批次 Tab 保留原测试 id（payroll-period-filter/payroll-status-filter/payroll-run-table）。无效 tab 回退到首个可见 Tab；工资条需 payroll.payslip.read.self，报表需 payroll.report.read。首页只读取批次；配置/工资条/报表按 Tab 懒挂载，不会在一次进入时请求全部接口。
薪资项目展示版本历史；复制新版本/停用仅在 payroll.run.prepare 时出现。金额只以整数分展示；费率/倍率为十进制字符串输入，不用浮点。员工薪资档案与调薪历史需 payroll.compensation.read，归档写入需 payroll.compensation.manage。
读取 /v1/payroll/runs 与 /v1/payroll/schemes；创建批次使用 Idempotency-Key 调用 POST /v1/payroll/runs。金额键缺失保持缺失并显示字段策略隐藏，绝不补 0。
只调用 GET /v1/payroll/payslips 读取本人已发布工资条；发布者还可读取已发布批次列表跳转到批次工资条。未授权能力时不发请求。
只调用 GET /v1/payroll/reports/summary；仅整数分合计与部门/期间分组，不渲染员工级工资。导出仍从批次详情发起并单独授权。
新增五个详情 Tab；动作栏仍按状态机和 capability 显示。导出只从 /v1/payroll/runs/{id}/exports/{bank|tax} 生成并下载服务端返回内容；不拼接下载 URL。

openapiOperations.response: 201 single envelope PayrollItemVersion; replay 200 + Idempotency-Replayed: true
openapiOperations.notes: version is server-owned; client-sent version is ignored. Overlap/retired/frozen are 409 with stable reasons.

openapiOperations.response: 200 single envelope PayrollItem with RETIRED status; repeated command replay is 200
openapiOperations.notes: History is retained; PAYROLL_ITEM_IN_USE when a future scheme references the item; PAYROLL_RUN_FROZEN when the current/version period is sealed.

openapiOperations.response: as_of, source, group_by, currency, items[], trend[], totals{gross_cents,deductions_cents,net_cents,employer_cost_cents}
openapiOperations.security: Aggregate only over PUBLISHED|PAID|CLOSED runs; no employee identifiers or employee wage rows; mixed-currency rows are 409 PAYROLL_REPORT_MIXED_CURRENCY.
openapiOperations.statusDetail: Controller/service implemented in M13; route/OpenAPI registration is owned by the lead.

openapiOperations.requiredChange: Response items now include one row per effective version: id,item_version_id,code,version,status,version_status,name,type,taxable,insurable,calculation,formula_json,sort_order,effective_from,effective_to,retired_at,retire_reason,is_current,is_retired. Prior name/type rows were one per identity item.
Creates identity + server version 1. amount_cents/base_salary_cents are prohibited (422); response uses the versioned item schema.

Server owns version=max+1 under lock; client version is ignored. items[].rate accepts an exact decimal string (scale >= 6) as well as rate_scaled integer; frozen valid_from periods return 409 PAYROLL_RUN_FROZEN.
Run detail review/inputs tabs consume the existing operation; no contract change.
Export tab uses the existing audited operations; no client-side URL assembly.

notes: Allowed file domain respected: only backend/app/Modules/Payroll/**, backend/database/migrations/2026_11_27_000150_add_payroll_item_versions.php, backend/tests/Feature/Payroll/**, frontend/src/modules/payroll/**, frontend/tests/unit/ payroll tests, and docs/implementation/M13/integration.json were written. backend/routes/api.php, docs/openapi/openapi.yaml, docs/generated/**, scripts/**, frontend/src/router/**, frontend/src/modules/payroll/pages/index.ts, frontend/src/views/timepay/**, IAM/Payroll Providers, BenefitController and BenefitService were not edited by M13.

Backend: payroll_items is identity-only after migration; payroll_item_versions is append-only with server-owned max(version)+1, structural effective_to closure, retirement stamps, no deletes. Model hooks reject business-field rewrites and deletes. Frozen PUBLISHED/PAID/CLOSED periods reject item/version/retire/scheme changes with PAYROLL_RUN_FROZEN.
Money is always integer cents; rates (overtime multiplier and scheme item rates) are exact decimal strings scaled at >= 1e6. No float money path was added.

Frontend: /payroll is a four-tab workspace (批次/配置/工资条/报表). Default /payroll remains the batches tab retaining payroll-period-filter, payroll-status-filter and payroll-run-table for existing tests. query aliases components|plans|employee-plans|adjustments map into the configuration tab; invalid tab falls back to the first visible tab.
The payroll configuration tab links to /benefits?tab=statutory and never renders or posts statutory parameters. It is the only payroll-side statutory affordance.
Run detail exposes inputs, review, disbursement, payslips and export tabs while preserving PayrollActionBar state/capability behaviour and the audited export operations.
Reports tab uses payroll.report.read only and only GET /v1/payroll/reports/summary; it lacks employee-level wage fields. The run-scoped exports remain gated by payroll.export and P3 field policy.

Tests were written but NOT RUN: backend/tests/Feature/Payroll/PayrollItemVersionTest.php, PayrollCatalogHttpTest.php; frontend/tests/unit/PayrollWorkspaceTabs.spec.ts, payrollItemVersion.spec.ts. Also updated existing frontend/tests/unit/PayrollWorkspace.spec.ts tab-aware expectations.

Syntax checks completed: php -l on every changed/created PHP file (migration, models, services, controllers, tests) and isolated vue-tsc type checks for payroll API/components/pages and the two new Vitest specs. PHPUnit, Vitest, Playwright, pnpm typecheck, openapi:generate, actions:generate and gate:all are NOT RUN per task instructions.

Lead integration checklist: (1) register the three routes; (2) add payroll.report.read to CapabilityCatalog and payroll role templates; (3) add OpenAPI operations/schemas and x-action-label values; (4) add action-input entries and regenerate page-actions; (5) extend checkpoint PermissionResourceCatalog to the two retained page codes; (6) delete the 11 legacy page entries/components and update PagePermissionCoverageTest/timePayModulePages.spec.ts/routeRegistry.spec.ts counts; (7) update payroll/workspace and payroll/run-detail requiredApis/actions in registry.ts; (8) add payroll_item_versions to ModuleBoundaryScanner's Payroll-owned table list.
